mapper.select: /* LeaveGrantStatusMapper.selectGrantById */ SELECT GRANT_ID AS grantId , CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , USER_CD AS userCd , LEAVE_CD AS leaveCd , STATUS AS status , EXPIRE_YN AS expireYn , DEL_YN AS delYn , GRANT_DAYS AS grantDays , USED_DAYS AS usedDays , AVAIL_TO_DATE AS availToDate FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_GRANT WHERE CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND GRANT_ID = #{grantId}
mapper.update: /* LeaveGrantStatusMapper.expireOverdueGrants */ UPDATE TB_USER_LEAVE_GRANT SET STATUS = 'EXPIRED' , EXPIRE_YN = 'Y' , EXPIRE_DATE = NOW() , UPDATE_NO = 'SYSTEM' , UPDATE_DATE = NOW() WHERE STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND AVAIL_TO_DATE < DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d')
